response.query: What conservative decision rules (e.g., target power 90% under worst-case ICC/exposure) and pilot sample sizes should trigger full roll‑out versus instrument revision?
response.answer: Conservative decision rules often require 90% target power under worst-case scenarios. Full roll-out typically follows if pilot sample sizes meet predefined statistical thresholds; otherwise, instrument revision is triggered.
